description: Solventum Corporation is a leading global healthcare company developing, manufacturing and commercializing a broad portfolio of solutions that leverages deep material science, data science and digital capabilities to address critical customer and patient needs, and it constantly seeks to enable the improvement of standards of care and move healthcare forward with innovation powered by insights, clinical intelligence, technology and manufacturing expertise, drawing on a more than 70-year history of discovering and innovating advanced solutions. Its solutions are relied on every day within the global healthcare industry to deliver higher-quality patient care, more efficient processes and workflows, and improved standards of safety and accuracy, and its products and services are present along a patient's journey through prevention, diagnosis, treatment and recovery, and development and protection of its proprietary technologies through intellectual property rights is a strategic priority, relying on a combination of patent, design, utility model, trademark, copyright and trade secret protections as well as regulatory exclusivity periods and confidentiality agreements.
